title: An agent in a worktree may run a long check as a background Bash run
why: Builders cannot run the 25-minute hooks/test_guard.py in the background, so they cut it into shards or block in the foreground (seen 06:35 and 09:39 CST Nov 8).
note: Filed 09:49 CST Nov 8 from lane notes-fix-page. hooks/guard.py:4948 passes run_in_background to judge_shell. Unmeasured: whether our guard or the harness refuses. First act: measure that and name the refusing rule; then a red case. Related: step waiter-wait-until (ready), which allows one bounded background wait.
